question: Select the most appropriate option for blank 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**extinction**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is about environmental pollution.
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is 'extinction'.
 
• '**Extinction**' means a situation in which something no longer exists. (ऐसी स्थिति जिसमें कोई चीज़ अब मौजूद नहीं है)
 
 
• **Example: **Many species have faced extinction due to human activities.
 
 
 
• The given passage states that so, many birds, animals, and plants are on the verge of extinction day by day. 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

**Correct Passage:__** *Pollution is destroying nature. The smoke that is emitted from the chimneys of the factories, and from vehicles is the mixture of poisonous gases. Due to environmental pollution, there is an imbalance in nature, so, many birds, animals, and plants are on the verge of **extinction** day by day. The only way to (4) _______ environmental pollution is to plant many trees. By planting trees, we can get rid of many harmful poisonous gases. It is the responsibility of everyone to (5) ______ and protect our environment. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__ **

 
• **Survival : (जीवन का जीना) **- The state of continuing to live or exist, typically in spite of difficult conditions.

 
 
• **Example:** The survival of the species is in danger.
 
 
 
• **Distinction : (भेद, फर्क)** - A difference or contrast between similar things or people; excellence that sets someone or something apart from others.
 
 
• **Example: **The distinction between right and wrong is not always clear.
 
 
 
• **Appearance : (दिखावा, स्वरूप) **- The way that someone or something looks.
 
 
• **Example: **The house had a bleak appearance.

The correct answer is '**eradicate**'.
